title: Litter Weight-Loss Watch
app: Fi collar, Petkit, Tractive, Petlibro, Litter-Robot, pet cameras, and aquarium controllers via vendor exports, Home Assistant integrations, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=litterrobot:cycle
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(weight_kg) as avg_weight_kg, count as cycles by pet _time
| streamstats current=f avg(avg_weight_kg) as baseline_weight_kg by pet
| where baseline_weight_kg>0 AND avg_weight_kg<baseline_weight_kg*0.95
| sort avg_weight_kg
description: Uses Litter-box weight telemetry telemetry to monitor weekly weight trends seen during litter-box use in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for subtle weight loss that deserves attention, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Litter-box weight telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Weekly pet table of average litter-box weight.
grandmaExplanation: It produces weekly weight trends seen during litter-box use so you can spot subtle weight loss that deserves attention before it becomes annoying.
